Definition: from G1770; dumb (as making signs), i.e. silent from astonishment:--speechless.
BiblicalUsage: The men travelling with Saul stood speechless in Acts 9:7 — hearing a voice but seeing no man — struck silent by astonishment on the Damascus road.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe there are moments when God leaves us with nothing to say, and silence is the right answer to glory we cannot explain.
